name: Brisk Walking Intervals

instructions.description: Walk easily to establish a comfortable rhythm.
Increase the pace for a planned interval while keeping technique relaxed.
Return to an easier pace for recovery.
Repeat the faster and easier phases as tolerated.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Comfortable-Pace Walking provides a meaningfully different loading, support, or stability option compared with Brisk Walking Intervals.
Brisk Walking Intervals — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Alternate faster and easier walking at individually manageable intensities.
